| h. August → September growth | -11.3% |

Things I checked in the data:
- **Email merging:** 300 customer accounts share 250 distinct emails, so b, e and f count by email.
- **Conflicting segments:** 37 of those emails have accounts in different segments. For (a), each order uses the segment of the account that placed it, so one person's sales can count under more than one segment.
- **Data quality:** every refund matches an order line, no line has more refund rows than one, and no line refunds more than it sold. All discount rates are between 0 and 100.
- **Other figures:** segment Q3 net sales were enterprise 305.8M, smb 276.9M and consumer 220.2M (원). Monthly net sales ran from 2025-05 to 2025-10, with August the highest.
